decision: No valid games-only historical workforce series from these broad industry codes

sources.title: CNAE subclasses 2.2: official explanatory notes
sources.methodology: PDF page429 places computer games for all platforms in 6203-1/00 alongside operating systems and general applications. Pages285-286 classify electronic game manufacturing separately and exclude videogame apparatus to2640-0/00.
sources.assessment: Do not use total6203-1/00 employment as games employment. Manufacturing label3240-0/01 is not a game-software developer category.
sources.access_status: Full original PDF downloaded and relevant pages extracted
sources.next_step: Historical code coverage verified; a separate company roster would be needed to isolate software games.

sources.title: IBGE online lookup: 6203-1/00
sources.methodology: Games and virtual game items appear among descriptors of a broader non-customizable software subclass.
sources.assessment: Descriptors are not separate statistical subclasses; cannot extract a national games workforce from the overall code.
sources.access_status: Official search-index text reviewed; direct web and HTTP both failed (403/internal error)
sources.next_step: Retain index/full-PDF access distinction; do not claim all current classification revisions audited.

sources.title: IBGE and Fiesp seminar: CNAE 3.0 implementation timetable
sources.methodology: Indexed official report quotes IBGE classification coordinator on planned CNAE3.0 implementation in2027.
sources.assessment: Planning evidence only: not implemented games-specific codes, historical crosswalk, or employment data.
sources.access_status: Official indexed text reviewed; full page returns403
sources.next_step: Check final adopted structure and crosswalk when available; do not treat an old strategic target as implementation proof.

sources.title: MTE announcement of six new occupations
sources.methodology: Original announcement linked by Abragames. Direct access redirects to restricted-content login.
sources.assessment: Unverified original instrument; no code, date or employment count accepted from this page.
sources.next_step: Find public official CBO structure and effective dates; no login required for current research.

sources.title: Abragames announcement: three games occupations recognized
sources.methodology: Association reports recognition of visual game artist, game designer and game narrative designer in CBO; links MTE announcement.
sources.assessment: Useful primary association lead. Occupations differ from industry; three roles do not capture whole games workforce or provide historical coverage.
sources.access_status: Association post text available in search index; underlying MTE page restricted
sources.next_step: Verify CBO codes/effective dates and reporting uptake before considering a separate occupation series.
